title: Most Frequent Number Following Key In an Array
goal: Find the most frequent value immediately following the key.
strategy: Only adjacent successors of key occurrences contribute. Count those values and retain the largest frequency; a key at the final position has no successor.

phasePurposes.start: Find the most frequent value immediately following the key.
phasePurposes.inspect: Only adjacent successors of key occurrences contribute. Count those values and retain the largest frequency; a key at the final position has no successor.
phasePurposes.update: Only adjacent successors of key occurrences contribute. Count those values and retain the largest frequency; a key at the final position has no successor.
phasePurposes.done: Find the most frequent value immediately following the key.

edgeCases: A final key has no following value
Consecutive keys can make the key its own successor
One qualifying adjacent pair determines the answer
